title: Indoor Room Temperature Sensor Error
shortDescription: The indoor ambient temperature sensor has malfunctioned.
fullDescription: Error code 01 on Hitachi air conditioners indicates the indoor room temperature thermistor is reading outside normal range.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off at breaker for 5 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove front panel. Check sensor near air intake.

fixSteps.title: Test thermistor
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect and test resistance (approx 10K ohms at 25C).

whenToCallPro: If sensor tests fine but error persists.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 01 error sensor fix

faq.a: Use model number from indoor unit label.

title: Indoor Coil Temperature Sensor Error
shortDescription: The indoor evaporator coil sensor has malfunctioned.
fullDescription: Error code 02 indicates the evaporator coil thermistor is returning abnormal readings.
whenToCallPro: If coil is heavily iced, refrigerant issue possible.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 02 error coil sensor fix

faq.a: Low airflow, low refrigerant, or faulty sensor.

title: Outdoor Coil Temperature Sensor Error
shortDescription: The outdoor condenser coil sensor has malfunctioned.
fullDescription: Error code 03 indicates the outdoor condenser coil temperature sensor is returning abnormal readings.
symptoms: Defrost not activating in heat mode

fixSteps.title: Check sensor attachment
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off power. Check sensor on condenser coil pipe.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install in same position on coil.

whenToCallPro: If sensor replacement does not clear error.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 03 error outdoor sensor fix

faq.q: More critical in heating or cooling?

faq.a: Yes. Can damage fins and strain fan.
Run cooling mode 10-15 min to melt ice.

title: Outdoor Ambient Temperature Sensor Error
shortDescription: The outdoor ambient temperature sensor has malfunctioned.
fullDescription: Error code 04 indicates the outdoor ambient sensor is reading abnormally.
symptoms: May not start in extreme temps

fixSteps.title: Locate sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Find on outdoor unit air intake area.

whenToCallPro: If sensor is fine but error persists.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 04 error outdoor ambient sensor fix

title: Compressor Overcurrent Protection
shortDescription: The compressor is drawing excessive current.
fullDescription: Error code 06 indicates compressor overcurrent, triggering protective shutdown.
whenToCallPro: If voltage low or compressor failing.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 06 error overcurrent fix

faq.a: Higher workload and possible voltage sag.

title: Indoor/Outdoor Communication Error
fullDescription: Error code 07 indicates the signal wire between indoor and outdoor units is broken or a communication circuit has failed.

fixSteps.title: Check connections
fixSteps.instruction: Tighten terminal screws at both units.

fixSteps.title: Test wire continuity
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect at both ends. Test each conductor.

fixSteps.title: Check for interference
fixSteps.instruction: Route signal wire away from power cables.

whenToCallPro: If wire and connections fine but error persists.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 07 error communication fix

title: Indoor Fan Motor Error
shortDescription: The indoor blower fan motor is not operating correctly.
fullDescription: Error code 08 indicates the indoor fan motor is not running at expected speed or has stopped.

fixSteps.title: Check connections
fixSteps.instruction: Verify fan motor connector is secure.

whenToCallPro: If motor needs replacement on wall-mounted unit.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 08 error indoor fan fix

faq.a: Not directly but can overheat motor.
Usually failed capacitor or seized bearing.

title: Outdoor Fan Motor Error
shortDescription: The outdoor condenser fan motor has failed.
fullDescription: Error code 09 indicates the outdoor fan motor is not operating as commanded.

fixSteps.title: Check for obstructions
fixSteps.instruction: Look for debris blocking fan blade.

fixSteps.title: Test motor
fixSteps.instruction: Test winding resistance. Replace if faulty.

videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 09 error outdoor fan fix

faq.a: If fan hums but spins with hand push, likely capacitor.

title: High Pressure Protection
shortDescription: Compressor discharge pressure exceeded safe limits.
fullDescription: Error code 10 indicates excessive high-side pressure causing compressor shutdown.

fixSteps.title: Clean condenser coil
fixSteps.instruction: Wash from inside out with hose.

whenToCallPro: If fan motor or refrigerant issues.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 10 error high pressure fix

title: Compressor Discharge Temperature Sensor Error
shortDescription: The discharge temperature sensor has malfunctioned.
fullDescription: Error code 13 indicates the compressor discharge temperature sensor is returning abnormal readings.

fixSteps.title: Check attachment
fixSteps.instruction: Verify sensor firmly on discharge line.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install in same position with good thermal contact.

whenToCallPro: If sensor replacement does not clear error.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 13 error discharge sensor fix

title: EEPROM Error
fullDescription: Error code 14 indicates the EEPROM on the control board has failed.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 14 error EEPROM board fix

title: Voltage Protection
shortDescription: Power supply voltage outside acceptable range.
fullDescription: Error code 19 indicates the incoming voltage is too high or too low for safe operation.

fixSteps.title: Check voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Measure at outlet. Within 10% of rated.

fixSteps.title: Dedicated circuit
fixSteps.instruction: Verify AC has its own circuit.

videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 19 error voltage fix

faq.a: Underlying voltage issue can damage appliances.

title: Anti-Freeze Protection
shortDescription: Indoor coil temperature dropped below freezing threshold.
fullDescription: Error code 21 triggers when the evaporator coil drops below safe minimum temperature.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 21 error frozen coil fix

title: Compressor Discharge Temperature Protection
shortDescription: Compressor discharge temperature exceeded safe limits.
fullDescription: Error code 22 indicates the compressor discharge temperature is too high.

fixSteps.title: Check for frost
fixSteps.instruction: Look for frost on suction line.

videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 22 error discharge temperature fix

faq.a: Protection prevents damage but repeated triggers shorten life.

title: Inverter Compressor Drive Error
shortDescription: The inverter drive circuit has detected a fault.
fullDescription: Error code 23 indicates the inverter board controlling the variable-speed compressor has a fault.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi air conditioner 23 error inverter fix

faq.a: Inverter uses variable speed compressor for efficiency.
Yes, a shorted compressor overloads it.
